role: Real MoSCoW release-scoping (Must/Should/Could/Won't-this-time) as literal classification logic — deliberately distinct from E-02's time-urgency classification, this is about whether a feature belongs in this release at all.
behaviorDescription: scopeRelease() classifies each feature via classifyMoscow(): explicit out-of-scope wins over everything else, then core-blocking or legal/compliance requirements are Must, no-workaround-exists is Should, a real workaround existing is Could. Verified against five real cases including the priority order before implementation. No LLM call needed — real, deterministic classification.
hardStops: Never overrides an explicit out-of-scope declaration, even for a feature that would otherwise be a Must
Never fabricates reasoning disconnected from the real input flags
